d: Chestnut brown hair is medium-length, styled with long side-swept bangs and a low ponytail. Sharp, golden-amber eyes maintain a focused expression on a mature, young-adult face. The build is lean and athletic, dressed in a sleek black and deep red formal suit featuring a long, split-tail coat with gold accents and a plunging neckline. A single red armored gauntlet covers the right hand, and a long, flowing red fabric ribbon extends from the shoulder.
